description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Insurity empowers insurance organizations to quickly capitalize on new opportunities by delivering the world’s most configurable, cloud\-native, easy\-to\-use, and intuitively analytical insurance software. Just as importantly, we empower our people by providing the tools, support, and opportunities they need to grow and succeed.

At Insurity, you’ll collaborate with some of the most creative and knowledgeable minds in insurance tech in a culture that fosters innovation, teamwork, and continuous learning. Our award\-winning onboarding experience welcomes and supports you from the moment you accept our offer.
   

  

 Ready to grow your career with an industry leader? Apply today—we’re excited to welcome you. \#UatInsurity
   

  

 What’s In It For U
   

  

* Work Where You Thrive: Find a hybrid work environment that allows you to enjoy great work\-life balance while staying connected and collaborative.
* Generous Time Off: Our leadership believes in taking the time you need, when you need it.
* Day One Health Benefits \+ Employer\-Matched Retirement Savings: You might think these are table stakes, but we know these matter to you.
* More Than Just Core Values: Our values are fundamental in how we attract, train, and retain top talent.
* Award\-Winning Onboarding Program: We set you up from the get\-go to make a significant impact from Day One and support you throughout your entire first year.
* Real Career Growth Opportunities: We love to promote from within, with over 25% of our open roles filled through internal applicants on average.
* Mentorship Program: We support a champion culture and growth mindset by pairing you with experienced, talented leaders to help you grow personally and professionally.
* Insurity Podcasts: Explore podcasts from our Learning \& Development team for deeper insight into Insurity products, company innovation, and the business as a whole.
* Continuous Learning Opportunities: Own your development with your own LinkedIn Learning and Kaplan licenses.
* Employee Referral Bonus: Once you come onboard, give Insurity the biggest compliment you can by referring someone to work here and earn a referral bonus.


 Insurity’s Next Sr. Business Analyst II
   

  

 You will play a key role in ensuring the successful delivery and quality of Insurity’s insurance software solution. As a Sr. Business Analyst II, your primary focus will be to support the team by bridging business needs with technology, gathering and analyzing requirements, and facilitating communication to ensure alignment and clarity.
   

  

 This role involves developing deep expertise in the insurance domain and insurance data warehouses, while collaborating during testing phases to validate business solutions. You will strengthen the team’s capabilities by translating complex insurance requirements into actionable insights and supporting the delivery of high\-value, high\-quality software.
   

  

 This role requires a strong commitment to the continuous development of both technical knowledge and business acumen, with a focus on commercial insurance processing and reporting requirements, including operational, financial, and regulatory needs. The role also requires a commitment to assessing and supporting ongoing process improvement.
   

  

 What Our Sr Business Analyst II Will Do
   

  

* Collaborate with teams and stakeholders to collect and clarify business and functional requirements.
* Drive automation and quality improvement from a business perspective by supporting testing strategy and validating requirements.
* Analyze current processes and systems to identify improvement opportunities aligned with project goals.
* Provide clear and concise documentation, including business requirements, presentation mockups, and acceptance criteria.
* Facilitate requirement workshops and stakeholder communication, ensuring alignment and timely decisions.
* Support user acceptance testing and coordinate defect resolution with cross\-functional teams.
* Perform and support testing efforts and artifacts, project status reporting, and requirement traceability documentation.
* Communicate project risks, concerns, and quality metrics to leadership and team members.
* Manage multiple priorities with strong time management and organizational skills.
* Participate in straightforward system design and configuration activities.


 Who We’re Looking For
   

  

* Recommended: 6\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in Commercial Insurance.
* Recommended: Bachelor’s degree in business, IT, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* Strong understanding of the insurance domain and commercial lines of business such as Auto, Property, and Liability.
* Experience engaging with technical and business stakeholders in Agile and/or Waterfall environments.
* Proficiency with requirement gathering and documentation tools.
* Ability to effectively translate complex insurance requirements to technical teams and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Self\-starter who thrives in a collaborative and evolving environment.
* Experience supporting testing activities and validating business scenarios.
* Familiarity with cloud\-native SaaS software development is preferred.
* Insurance\-related certifications such as AINS or CPCU are a plus.


 Closing Note
   

  

 Thank you for your interest in Insurity. Please understand that due to the volume of applicants we receive, only selected candidates will be contacted.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Business Analyst – Data, Analytics and AI**
**The Opportunity**
 As a Business Analyst (Data, Analytics and AI) at EY, you will play a pivotal role in shaping, governing, and delivering data‑driven and AI‑enabled solutions for Clients \& Industries (C\&I) and select EY‑wide initiatives. You will be part of the Data Strategy team, operating at the intersection of business, analytics, and AI to ensure that Analytics and Copilot‑led agentic solutions are aligned to strategic objectives and deliver measurable business value.
   

  

 This role combines hands‑on delivery with ownership of analytics and AI governance, operating models, and value realization. You will act as the Business Analyst on Data Analytics and AI initiatives, while also contributing to data strategy, metric standardization, and trusted data foundations across C\&I.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Business Analysis \& Stakeholder Leadership**
* Lead discovery and requirements definition for data, analytics, and AI initiatives across Clients \& Industries.
* Partner with senior stakeholders to shape business problems into clear analytics and AI use cases with defined success measures.
* Translate business needs into structured requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria aligned to delivery backlogs.
* Act as a trusted advisor, balancing strategic objectives with execution‑focused delivery.


**Data Strategy, Governance \& Operating Model**
* Contribute to C\&I data strategy by identifying priority data domains, decision journeys, and analytics opportunities.
* Define and govern enterprise KPIs, metrics, and reporting standards to ensure consistency and trust.
* Maintain business glossaries, metric definitions, and analytics standards aligned with data governance practices.


**Data Collection, Data Quality \& Trusted Data**
* Define data collection requirements including sources, granularity, frequency, ownership, and quality expectations.
* Identify data gaps, quality issues, and remediation needs. Establish validation rules and “trusted data” criteria for analytics and AI use cases.
* Ensure compliance with EY data security, privacy, and regulatory standards, including GDPR.


**Analytics Delivery, Insights \& Value Realization**
* Partner with analytics teams to deliver actionable insights and executive‑ready narratives.
* Validate dashboards, reports, and AI outputs for accuracy, relevance, and business alignment.
* Drive adoption through enablement, walkthroughs, and targeted stakeholder communication.
* Identify optimization opportunities to enhance analytics and AI impact.
* Provide functional guidance to junior Data Engineers and ensure clarity of requirements and priorities.
* Collaborate across global, multi‑disciplinary C\&I teams to deliver outcomes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* AI‑first mindset with strong interest in Copilot‑led solutions and intelligent automation.
* Strong Business Analysis capability in data‑ and analytics‑heavy environments.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands‑on delivery and execution rigor.
* Executive presence and confidence engaging senior stakeholders as a trusted partner.
* Strong relationship‑building and influencing skills across business and technology teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complexity.
* Strong judgment, structured thinking, and operational discipline in a fast‑paced environment.
* Ability to operate effectively across geographies, cultures, and service lines.


**Technical Expertise**
* Strong working knowledge of data and analytics concepts (KPIs, data models, data quality, data lineage).
* Proficiency in SQL for data validation and analysis; familiarity with Python is advantageous.
* Experience with Power BI (preferred) or similar visualization tools (Tableau, Spotfire).
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure analytics services (e.g., Data Factory, Synapse, Data Lake) from a requirements and design perspective.
* Experience with Copilot Studio for defining and validating AI agent solutions.
* Familiarity with Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) integration patterns.
* Exposure to Alteryx preferred but not mandatory.


**What We Look For**
* We are looking for Manager‑level professionals who can combine data strategy, analytics delivery, and AI enablement to drive tangible business outcomes for Clients \& Industries. You should be a structured problem solver, a strong communicator, and a collaborative leader who can operate comfortably across strategy, governance, and execution.
* If you are excited about shaping data‑driven and Copilot‑enabled experiences at scale, we encourage you to apply and be part of our journey.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

description:
Role & responsibilities Payroll Associate II performs US payroll-related functions, including payroll processing, payroll tax compliance, automated timekeeping systems and payroll reporting in a multi-site, multi-state, high-volume environment for UKG Inc.s customers who utilize our Managed Services product offering. Payroll Specialist II provides excellent customer service to managers and associates and is well versed in payroll compliance, taxes and reporting. Performs payroll-related functions including but not limited to payroll processing, audits and maintenance. Ability to perform all duties of Payroll Associate I as well as: Adjustments/amendments GL Balancing and auditing Tax Reconciliation Complete Peer Reviews Processes payroll(s) for multi-frequency Managed Services clients as scheduled Performs file imports into payroll system from various sources and reviews and verifies payroll data in a timely manner. Prepare off-cycle payrolls and manual checks as necessary. Escalates non-routine inquiries and issues to Payroll Specialist, Team Lead or Manager utilizing the proper escalation methodology and SLAs. Build strong partnership with clients by providing superior service. Participate in cross-training within other departments (HRIS, Benefits, Garnishment, Tax) Identifies areas of client dissatisfaction and proposes solutions and coordinates with Team Lead or Manager to resolve Develops and maintains awareness of SSAE16 requirements and accountable for compliance of each task performed. Demonstrates excellent troubleshooting, root cause analysis skills and is able to implement preventative measures. Reconciles all payroll-related accounts and activities. Mentor Payroll Analyst I team members and assist with development. Conduct knowledge transfer and/or participate in training Assists with related special projects as required. Performs other duties as assigned by manager. Maintain discretion and professionalism with team members and clients. Quarter End, Year End, and Open Enrollment assistance and task execution 
 Preferred candidate profile Quickly and easily adapts to change and shifting priorities with enthusiasm. Actions and words consistently provide positive motivation and influence to their team and other teams within UMS. Understands priorities and what is most important to both internal and external customers. Eagerly meets business opportunities and challenges head-on. Leads by example. Proficient report writing capabilities. Experience with large corporate payroll processing that includes exposure to benefits and 401(k) Knowledge of multi-state North American payroll tax laws Detail oriented, exhibiting strong organizational, problem-solving, and analytical skills. Advanced knowledge using the Microsoft Office Suite of software to include Outlook, Word and Excel, including VLOOKUP, formulas, and data analysis. Ability to analyze and resolve problems. Ability to understand and follow written and verbal instructions. Ability to deal effectively with a diversity of individuals at all organizational levels. Coordinate multiple tasks simultaneously. Experience Bachelor's degree or equivalent A minimum of 2 to 4 years US payroll experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience. 
 Preferred Qualifications Working knowledge of UKGPro is a plus. Knowledge of US and Canadian payroll laws. Experience with large corporate payroll processing that includes exposure to benefits and 401(k) Knowledge of multi-state US Payroll tax laws FPC certification is a plus

Key Skills: US Payroll,US Payroll Processing,401K,W2,Payroll processing,Payroll,Processing,Process

title: Finance Analytics Professional
description:
Job Description 
Data analysts import, inspect, clean, transform, validate, model, or interpret collections of data with regard to the business goals of the company. They ensure that the data sources and repositories provide consistent and reliable data. Data analysts use different algorithms and IT tools as demanded by the situation and the current data. They might prepare reports in the form of visualizations such as graphs, charts, and dashboards. 
 Job Description - Grade Specific 
The role combines leadership, technical expertise, and project management skills to ensure the successful delivery of data analysis projects and the development of a high performing data analyst team. They play a critical role in leveraging data to drive business growth, optimize processes, and enable informed decision making across the organization.
